verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM's first-party docs cover each element of the story. Sync both ways runs through REST CRUD endpoints (100 records per insert call) and an async Bulk API that can insert, update or upsert up to 25,000 records per call, with job-completion callbacks. Change detection comes from Notifications channels with field-level triggers and channel expiry. Rate limits are documented through an API-credits page and the X-API-CREDITS-REMAINING header. Missing for 10: concrete rate-limit figures in the evidence (only the credits header is shown), explicit incremental-sync support such as modified-since filtering, and independent or hands-on corroboration of sync at scale.
